title: International Focus
tagline: Building Global Resilience. Advancing Innovation. Creating Sustainable Opportunities.
intro: Climate change, health emergencies, food insecurity and economic instability are interconnected, and so are their solutions. LDII bridges knowledge and resource gaps between the Global North and Global South, so that institutions and communities can work together on lasting social, economic and environmental progress.

principles.title: Knowledge Exchange & Research
principles.text: Sharing research, expertise and proven practices across countries and sectors.

principles.title: Technology Transfer & Innovation
principles.text: Improving access to appropriate technologies and technical expertise.

principles.title: Capacity Building
principles.text: Strengthening leadership, professional skills and institutional effectiveness.

principles.title: Partnerships & Resource Mobilization
principles.text: Connecting partners and resources to collaborative initiatives.

principles.title: Inclusive Development
principles.text: Putting the needs of disadvantaged communities at the centre.

delivery: We deliver these through conferences, workshops, policy dialogues, research collaborations and professional exchanges.

areas.title: Climate Action & Environmental Resilience
areas.summary: Climate and environmental crises threaten livelihoods, food security and economic stability, and they hit vulnerable populations hardest. We help communities and institutions anticipate, withstand and recover from them.
bullets: Drought, water scarcity and sustainable water management
Climate education, with a focus on women, children and marginalized communities
areas.imageAlt: The LDII delegation outdoors in Greater Sudbury, a city known worldwide for its regreening

areas.title: Mining Innovation & Sustainable Resource Development
areas.tagline: Connecting Global Expertise. Empowering Sustainable Development.
areas.summary: We partner with Canadian universities, colleges, mining companies and technology providers to give mining professionals from the Global South access to modern expertise and practical training.
bullets: Specialized training for engineers, technicians and researchers
Responsible investment in the mining sector
areas.imageAlt: The LDII delegation underground in hard hats during the Greater Sudbury mining visit

link.label: Global South–Canada Mining & Technology Transfer Mission

areas.title: International Trade & Economic Empowerment
areas.summary: Tariffs, trade wars and supply-chain disruptions fall hardest on developing economies and small businesses. We promote inclusive trade frameworks that build long-term stability.
bullets: Fair trade and equitable market access
Business forums and cross-border investment partnerships
areas.imageAlt: Delegates before the Canadian and South African flags at the Canada–South Africa economic outlook seminar

areas.title: Global Health & Pandemic Preparedness
areas.tagline: Strengthening Health Systems. Advancing Health Equity.
areas.summary: COVID-19 showed that strong public health infrastructure and international cooperation save lives. We support better-prepared, more equitable health systems.
areas.imageAlt: IGAD’s Director of Health and Social Development speaking beside the EU-IGAD COVID-19 response banner, Toronto, July 2024

areas.title: Food Security & Resilient Food Systems
areas.summary: Climate change, conflict, rising costs and fragile supply chains threaten food availability and affordability. We work toward food systems that can withstand these shocks.
bullets: Food supply chains and market stability
Community food security for vulnerable populations
areas.imageAlt: Delegates visiting a food store stocked with sacks of produce, Toronto, July 2024

areas.title: Sustainable Investment & Social Enterprise
areas.summary: Lasting development needs investment that serves communities as well as balance sheets. We connect capital to local priorities, with transparency and accountability.
areas.imageAlt: A handshake with the Brampton Board of Trade

cta.title: Partner With Us
cta.text: Whether you represent a university, government, business or community organization, we would welcome the chance to explore how we can work together.
